title: Table theme gallery
Table theme gallery
text: Four cars, simple title, row labels, spanners performance fuel economy keep structure small enough compare glance.
code: cars_data <- gtcars[order(gtcars$msrp, decreasing = TRUE), ] cars_data <- cars_data[   seq_len(4),   c("model", "hp", "trq", "mpg_c", "mpg_h") ]  simple_table <- cars_data |>   gt(rowname_col = "model") |>   tab_header(title = "High-performance cars") |>   tab_stubhead(label = "Model") |>   tab_spanner(label = "Performance", columns = c(hp, trq)) |>   tab_spanner(label = "Fuel economy (mpg)", columns = c(mpg_c, mpg_h)) |>   cols_label(     hp = "HP",     trq = "Torque (lb-ft)",     mpg_c = "City",     mpg_h = "Highway"   ) |>   fmt_integer(columns = c(hp, trq, mpg_c, mpg_h))

title: Table theme gallery
text: Aggregate pizza sales category size. dataset row represents one pizza sold, count measures pizzas rather distinct orders. sizes retained, including XL XXL, grand total covers entire dataset. category column defines row groups (groupname_col), size supplies stub labels (rowname_col). additive quantities receive totals; average prices left blank summary rows.
code: pizza_source <- data.frame(   category = gt::pizzaplace$type,   size = gt::pizzaplace$size,   pizzas = 1L,   revenue = gt::pizzaplace$price ) pizza_data <- aggregate(   cbind(pizzas, revenue) ~ category + size,   data = pizza_source,   FUN = sum ) pizza_data$average_price <- pizza_data$revenue / pizza_data$pizzas pizza_data$size <- factor(   pizza_data$size,   levels = c("S", "M", "L", "XL", "XXL") ) pizza_data <- pizza_data[order(pizza_data$category, pizza_data$size), ] complete_table <- pizza_data |>   gt(rowname_col = "size", groupname_col = "category") |>   tab_header(     title = "Pizza sales by category and size",     subtitle = "Full-year sales, 2015"   ) |>   tab_stubhead(label = "Category / size") |>   tab_spanner(label = "Sales", columns = c(pizzas, revenue)) |>   cols_label(     pizzas = "Pizzas sold",     revenue = "Revenue",     average_price = "Average price"   ) |>   fmt_integer(columns = pizzas) |>   fmt_currency(columns = c(revenue, average_price), currency = "USD") |>   summary_rows(     groups = everything(),     columns = pizzas,     fns = list(Total = ~ sum(.)),     fmt = ~ fmt_integer(.)   ) |>   summary_rows(     groups = everything(),     columns = revenue,     fns = list(Total = ~ sum(.)),     fmt = ~ fmt_currency(., currency = "USD")   ) |>   grand_summary_rows(     columns = pizzas,     fns = list("Grand total" = ~ sum(.)),     fmt = ~ fmt_integer(.)   ) |>   grand_summary_rows(     columns = revenue,     fns = list("Grand total" = ~ sum(.)),     fmt = ~ fmt_currency(., currency = "USD")   ) |>   tab_footnote(     footnote = "Counts pizzas sold, not distinct orders; an order can contain several pizzas.",     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = pizzas)   ) |>   tab_footnote(     footnote = "Revenue divided by pizzas sold within each category and size.",     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = average_price)   ) |>   tab_source_note(     source_note = md("Source: **gt::pizzaplace**, pizza sales in 2015.")   )

title: Apply a Minimal Hokusai Theme to GT Tables — gt_theme_hokusai
text: palettes stored explicit hex values R/utils.R. Mountain uses supplied mountain landscape, wind windy field, blossom bullfinch weeping cherry, lake lakeside landscape. Blues paper colors extracted digital reproductions; summary fills lightened paper tones neutral white canvas. palettes include shared neutral gray scale (gray_50 gray_900). Zebra stripes use gray_100, gridlines use gray_200, structural dividers use gray_300. Body text column labels use dark gray; subtitles notes use softer dark gray. Blue emphasizes titles, group headings, summaries. Column labels sit body size set semibold. Stub cells also semibold. Families ship semibold separate family name, Host Grotesk, named label stub font stacks weight resolves. Apply theme cell-specific highlighting. Font arguments options follow gt_theme_ekio().

text: Color tokens now resolve name, including named shades local basic brand colors, informative errors unknown colors. gt_theme_ekio() now uses Lora titles supports configurable title, body, numeric, label fonts arguments options. gt_theme_ekio() validates arguments preserves styles across tables missing partially populated summary groups. Text blue fills follows palette contrast choice. gt_theme_ekio() now uses former alternative styling, unfilled group headings, Baltic Blue rules, tabular numerals, automatic footer. experimental gt_theme_ekio_alt() name removed. gt_theme_hokusai() adds minimal blue theme four palettes extracted Hokusai reproductions: mountain, wind, blossom, lake. shared neutral gray scale supplies gridline, divider, zebra stripe colors. gt_theme_hokusai() supports optional light-gray cell gridlines gridlines = TRUE uses dark-gray body text, column labels, subtitles, notes, reserving blue emphasis.
